semantics.timing: Combinational continuous response to inputs; no clock or cycle latency.
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior.
semantics.initialization: No stored state or initialization requirement. Output follows current inputs.

numeric.type: Single-bit unsigned logic inputs and output
numeric.arithmetic: No arithmetic, rounding, truncation, overflow, or saturation.

verification.plan: Independent self-checking testbench drives all four binary input pairs and compares against explicit truth-table expected constants after combinational settling; repeat in reverse order to check input response.
verification.compile: Icarus v12, -g2012, explicit dev_tb top, finite external timeout
verification.simulation: Matching vvp with finite external timeout and testbench watchdog; fatal on mismatch, explicit PASS on completion
verification.review: Check exact port names and widths, continuous combinational assignment, no state, delays, or dependencies in DUT.
